name: Glowwood Ruin Court — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Aged pointed-arch ruin court with broken tower/arch tops, roots and moss climbing stone, pale lilac/blue crystal clusters, star niches and a purple suspended star beneath the main arch. Open voids remain between walls; source is not a sealed chapel. Hidden layout inference: A woodland path crosses a small stone circle into the open court, passes a central wishing/crystal focus, then exits through a broken side arch into a grove. Leave roof absent and preserve framed sky/tree views. Keep vegetation at boundaries so broken edges and routes remain legible. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B17-STRUCT-001 — Glowwood Ruin Court — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need broken-wall/arch foot/return variants and root-to-stone attachment views, not another intact Gothic church. Reuse existing crystal/wish-star and moss/fern families after identity check. Suspension of star is unresolved or explicitly magical; owl/moths and possible firefly effects proposed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.

B17-STRUCT-001-S01 — Broken arch/springing. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 6, 12]m proposed. One isolated broken arch/springing matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
